title: pellaea muelleri
intro: Pellaea muelleri, commonly known as the Mueller's chain fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea muelleri include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to protect against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
